```{r}
divided_diff <- function(x, y){
  dd <- y
  n <- length(y)
  
  if(n>1){
    for (i in 2:n){
      for (j in n:i){
        dd[j] = (dd[j] - dd[j-1]) / (x[j] - x[j-i+1])
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(dd)
}

```


```{r}
tests <- list(
  list(name = "Single point",
       x = c(2), y = c(5),
       expected = c(5)),

  list(name = "Linear polynomial",
       x = c(0, 2), y = c(1, 5),
       expected = c(1, 2)),

  list(name = "Quadratic polynomial",
       x = c(0, 2, 3), y = c(1, 3, 0),
       expected = c(1, 1, -4/3)),

  list(name = "Polynomial through origin",
       x = c(0, 1, 2), y = c(0, 1, 4),
       expected = c(0, 1, 1)),

  list(name = "Constant function",
       x = c(1, 2, 3, 4), y = c(7, 7, 7, 7),
       expected = c(7, 0, 0, 0)),

  list(name = "Cubic polynomial",
       x = c(-1, 0, 1, 2), y = c(-7, -1, -1, 1),
       expected = c(-7, 6, -3, 4/3)),

  list(name = "Negative x values",
       x = c(-2, 0, 2), y = c(5, 1, 5),
       expected = c(5, -2, 1)),

  list(name = "Unsorted x values",
       x = c(3, 0, 2), y = c(0, 1, 3),
       expected = c(0, -1/3, -4/3))
)
```

```{r}
results <- lapply(tests, function(test) {
  actual <- divided_diff(test$x, test$y)

  data.frame(
    Test = test$name,
    Passed = isTRUE(all.equal(
      unname(actual),
      unname(test$expected),
      tolerance = 1e-8
    )),
    Expected = paste(signif(test$expected, 7), collapse = ", "),
    Actual = paste(signif(actual, 7), collapse = ", ")
  )
})

knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, results), row.names = FALSE)
```
